title: MONDAY LEGS AND LUNGS
subtitle: MONDAY. WEIGH-IN DAY. CHAIR SQUATS, STEP-UPS, REVERSE LUNGES, SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE, HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH, CAT-COW. LEGS UNDER YOU, HIPS OPEN, LUNGS AWAKE.

script.welcome: MONDAY, GRIMES. LEGS AND LUNGS. SIXTEEN MINUTES. YOU STOOD ON THE SCALE THIS MORNING, NOW YOU STAND ON YOUR OWN TWO FEET AND MAKE THEM WORK. WHATEVER THE NUMBER SAID, THE LEGS DON'T CARE. ON YOUR FEET.
script.rest: REST. HANDS OFF THE KEYBOARD. THE EMAILS WILL STILL BE THERE.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE. FINISH LIKE YOU MEAN IT. EYES ON YOU.
script.complete: DISMISSED. LEGS WORKED, BALANCE TESTED, HIPS OPENED, SPINE OILED. THAT IS HOW A WEEK STARTS. NOW GO SIT DOWN AND PRETEND YOU'RE NOT PROUD OF YOURSELF. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: CHAIR SQUATS
exercises.cue: STAND IN FRONT OF A STURDY CHAIR, FEET HIP-WIDTH, TOES SLIGHTLY OUT. ARMS FORWARD FOR BALANCE. SIT THE HIPS BACK AND DOWN UNTIL YOU TAP THE SEAT, DON'T FLOP. KNEES TRACK OVER TOES. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEELS AND STAND TALL. 3 SECONDS DOWN.
exercises.speakStart: CHAIR SQUATS. THREE SETS OF TEN. HIPS BACK, TAP THE SEAT, DO NOT SIT AND HAVE A LITTLE HOLIDAY. THREE SECONDS DOWN, DRIVE UP THROUGH THE HEELS. YOU SIT IN A CHAIR ALL DAY, GRIMES. TIME TO GET OUT OF ONE PROPERLY.
exercises.speakDone: SQUATS DONE. LEGS SWITCHED ON. GOOD.

exercises.name: STEP-UPS (BOTTOM STAIR)
exercises.cue: BOTTOM STAIR, HAND ON THE RAIL IF YOU WANT IT. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP. PRESS THROUGH THAT HEEL AND STAND ALL THE WAY UP, THEN STEP DOWN UNDER CONTROL. ALTERNATE LEADING LEGS. STEADY PACE, BREATHE.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. BOTTOM STAIR. THREE SETS OF THIRTY SECONDS. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP, STAND ALL THE WAY UP, STEP DOWN SOFT. SWAP LEGS. THIS IS THE LUNGS PART, GRIMES. IF YOU CAN SING, GO FASTER. IF YOU CAN'T TALK, EASE OFF.
exercises.speakDone: STEP UPS DONE. LUNGS OPEN. GOOD.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGES
exercises.cue: STAND TALL NEXT TO A WALL OR CHAIR FOR A FINGERTIP IF NEEDED. STEP ONE FOOT BACK, LOWER THE BACK KNEE TOWARD THE FLOOR, FRONT KNEE OVER THE ANKLE. TORSO UPRIGHT. PUSH THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL TO RETURN. ONLY GO AS DEEP AS IS COMFORTABLE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO ROUNDS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK, DROP THE BACK KNEE, CHEST UP, PUSH BACK THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL. FINGERTIP ON THE CHAIR IS LEGAL. COLLAPSING LIKE A DECKCHAIR IS NOT.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE
exercises.cue: STAND TALL NEXT TO A CHAIR OR WALL, FINGERTIPS ON IT IF NEEDED. SOFT KNEE ON THE STANDING LEG. HINGE AT THE HIP, TORSO FORWARD, FREE LEG REACHING BACK, BODY LIKE A SEESAW. GO ONLY AS FAR AS YOU CAN STAY SQUARE. RISE SLOW. 5 PER LEG.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG HINGE. BALANCE WORK. TWO ROUNDS, FIVE EACH LEG. SOFT KNEE, TIP FORWARD, BACK LEG LONG, HIPS SQUARE. SLOW ON THE WAY UP. WOBBLING IS FINE. TOPPLING INTO THE PRINTER IS PAPERWORK.
exercises.speakDone: BALANCE DONE. STEADIER EVERY WEEK. I NOTICED.

exercises.name: HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH WITH REACH
exercises.cue: HALF-KNEEL, ONE KNEE DOWN (CUSHION UNDER IT), OTHER FOOT FORWARD. TUCK THE TAILBONE AND SQUEEZE THE GLUTE ON THE KNEELING SIDE, SHIFT HIPS GENTLY FORWARD. REACH THE SAME-SIDE ARM OVERHEAD AND SLIGHTLY AWAY. FEEL THE FRONT OF THE HIP. HOLD 30, SWITCH. CHAIR NEARBY FOR SUPPORT.
exercises.speakStart: HIP FLEXOR STRETCH. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN, TUCK THE TAIL, SQUEEZE THE CHEEK, HIPS FORWARD, ARM UP AND OVER. THAT IS EIGHT HOURS OF DESK CHAIR YOU'RE UNKNOTTING. BREATHE INTO IT.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. INHALE: DROP THE BELLY, LIFT CHEST AND TAILBONE, EYES FORWARD (COW). EXHALE: ROUND THE SPINE UP, TUCK CHIN AND TAILBONE (CAT). SLOW, ONE BREATH EACH WAY.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. TWO ROUNDS OF EIGHT. BREATHE IN, BELLY DOWN, CHEST UP. BREATHE OUT, ROUND THE BACK LIKE AN ANGRY CAT. YOUR FAVOURITE, GRIMES. YOUR REWARD FOR NOT WHINGING. SLOW.
exercises.speakRest: FIFTEEN. SIT BACK ON YOUR HEELS.
exercises.speakDone: SPINE OILED. THAT IS MONDAY DONE. DISMISSED.
